items.headline: Faith-based nonprofit seeks to use former school on East Weddell Drive
items.summary: The November 25 Zoning Administrator hearing agenda listed a use permit request for Bay Area Cultural Connections, a nonprofit faith-based community organization, to occupy a former school facility at 539 East Weddell Drive as a community-serving place of assembly.

items.headline: 543 apartments proposed on Humboldt Court in Moffett Park, including 187 affordable units
items.summary: The November 23 special Planning Commission study session agenda listed a proposal from TruAmerica affiliate TAP BFR Acquisitions to replace a 50,000-square-foot office building at 220 Humboldt Court with 543 apartments. It would include an eight-story, 356-unit rental building with a three-level garage, plus a five-story building with 187 affordable units.

items.headline: Nine townhome-style condos proposed for 760 Golden Oak Court
items.summary: The November 23 Planning Commission study session agenda listed a proposal to demolish a one-story single-family house on a 0.35-acre lot and build nine townhome-style condominiums in two three-story buildings. The lot would be subdivided into three lots, including a common lot.

items.headline: Primrose preschool for up to 192 kids proposed on Homestead Road
items.summary: The November 23 Planning Commission agenda listed a proposal carried over from November 9. It calls for demolishing a vacant commercial building at 855 E. Homestead Road and building a 16,000-square-foot, two-story child care and preschool center for up to 192 children. The plan includes an eight-foot masonry wall along the western property line and part of the southern property line.

items.headline: Cupertino council agenda lists closed session on two lawsuits against the city
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed a closed-session conference with legal counsel on two existing cases in Santa Clara County Superior Court. They are Lixin (Leon) Chen, et al. v. City of Cupertino, et al., and Yes in My Backyard, et al. v. City of Cupertino, et al.

items.headline: Cupertino council agenda includes ordinance on councilmember compensation
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed an ordinance amending Municipal Code Section 2.16.020 on City Council compensation. The same agenda listed subcommittee recommendations on the Community Funding Policy and festival fee waivers.

items.headline: 590-home El Camino Real project listed for deferral
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed an item to postpone consideration of a vesting tentative subdivision map and development agreement for a mixed-use project at 2610 El Camino Real. It includes 590 homes and 15,000 square feet of commercial space. The project is subject to state SB 330 housing rules.

items.headline: Santa Clara electric rates proposed to rise 2% in January
items.summary: The November 17 City Council agenda listed a public hearing on a resolution raising electric rates and charges by 2.0% in every rate schedule for all customer classes, effective January 1, 2027.
